websiteNote: From 1 pages of their campaign website.

Taxes and spending.summary: Says they expect to pass another tax cut in the next legislative session.
Taxes and spending.quote: I’m confident that in the next legislative session, we will be able to do an additional tax cut, letting you keep more of your hard-earned money

Health care.summary: Says the state's Medicaid expansion should help people while they need it and then help them move off the program.
Health care.quote: The goal should be to help move people off of that program, provide assistance while they need it, and get them back on their own two feet.

Schools and education.summary: Says education freedom opens up opportunity for every child in Arkansas.
Schools and education.quote: Education freedom opens up endless opportunity for every single child growing up in Arkansas.

Jobs and the economy.summary: Says each economic development project should be judged on its own.
Jobs and the economy.quote: At the same time, you have to look at every single economic development project independently.

Public safety.summary: Says the death penalty must be handled with great care because it cannot be undone.
Public safety.quote: It’s the only decision that you make that you can’t undo. We have to get it right.

Immigration.summary: Says they signed a law with tougher penalties for immigrants here illegally who commit more crimes and will have the National Guard help enforce federal immigration law.
Immigration.quote: I signed the Defense Against Criminal Illegals Act to hold these criminals accountable and slap enhanced penalties on illegal immigrants who commit additional crimes while in our state, and I look forward to our guardsmen working with the Trump Administration to enforce federal immigration law.
